info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Financial Compliance Insights API
info.description: The Financial Compliance Insights API provides access to vital financial accounting data essential for auditing and compliance assessments. Users can retrieve detailed records and ensure adherence to regulatory standards. This API supports financial institutions and compliance officers who need to monitor and validate accounting transactions effectively. It facilitates the seamless integration of financial insights into corporate compliance frameworks, enhancing transparency and decision-making processes.

get.summary: Retrieve compliance details for financial accounting.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to retrieve compliance details associated with the financial accounting resource identified by ACC-200045. Ensure you have the necessary permissions to access this information.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve financial accounting information for the specified account. It contains parameters related to compliance and financial data filtering.
